config.sharedRetreat: AI-RETREAT-010 minimalAgent on both seats in all eight games
config.runOrder: 1017 experiment GERMAN, then 1018 experiment GERMAN; no old-version or Soviet-seat matches
config.exposureDefinition: For each UnitAdvanced, count UnitStepLost and UnitDestroyed for that unit during the next opposing side's phases; end at next own side phase, game end is censored. Also report matched baseline unit losses in same turn window.
config.rngLimitation: Identical initial seed does not align later battle dice if different actions change RNG draw consumption.
config.decisionRule: No retuning or expansion. Abandon adoption if near-all-PASS/return to baseline or if claimed mobility/objective benefit is unsupported; distinguish synthetic retained opportunities from actual games. No claim of overall strength from zero losses, fewer advances, or C156 alone.
config.guard: Exclude candidate iff identified enemy ID set adjacent to destination minus set adjacent to origin is nonempty; continue other candidates.
config.mobilityDefinition: For each accepted advance, inspect advanced unit at first and last following own movement decision; record alive/hasMoved, visible adjacency, finite scorer moves and actual forward MOVE. Offline Core neighbor legality is audit-only. Compare original advances with denominator and same-unit/turn checkpoints; do not infer benefit from fewer advances alone.
config.protectionCounting: Report distinct offered windows, legacy-eligible unit candidates excluded, windows with any exclusion, changed choice vs original policy on same DTO, retained candidates declined. Do not conflate candidate counts with decisions.
